title: UzEngine Animation Sequence
description: UzEngine animation sequence file (.uzanimsequence) — skeletal animation with per-bone keyframes, curves, and animation events (notifies). JSON header defines metadata; binary keyframe data is stored in the companion .uzpak or loose binary blob.

skeleton.description: Path to the skeleton asset (.uzskeleton) this animation was authored for.

frame_rate.description: Authoring frame rate (FPS). Keyframes are stored at this rate; runtime interpolates.

looping.description: Whether this animation is designed to loop seamlessly.

additive.description: If true, keyframes are stored as deltas from a reference pose (for additive blending layers).

additive_ref_frame.description: Reference frame index for additive animations. Deltas are computed relative to this frame.

root_motion.description: Root motion extraction settings. When enabled, the root bone's translation/rotation is extracted and applied to the entity transform instead of the skeleton.

enabled.description: Extract root motion from the root bone.

lock_vertical.description: Zero out vertical (Y) root motion. Useful for locomotion where gravity handles vertical movement.

lock_rotation.description: Do not extract rotational root motion.

tracks.description: Per-bone animation tracks. Each track contains keyframes for a specific bone's transform channels.

bone.description: Target bone name (must match a bone in the referenced skeleton).

position_keys.description: Number of position keyframes. Actual data stored in binary blob.

rotation_keys.description: Number of rotation keyframes (quaternion). Actual data stored in binary blob.

scale_keys.description: Number of scale keyframes. Actual data stored in binary blob.

compression.description: Keyframe compression mode. 'quantized': fixed-point 16-bit. 'curve_reduced': key reduction with error threshold.

curves.description: Named float curves for driving material parameters, blend weights, or gameplay values during playback.

name.description: Curve name referenced by game code (e.g., 'foot_ik_weight', 'opacity').

key_count.description: Number of keyframes. Data in binary blob as [time, value] pairs.

notifies.description: Animation events (notifies) triggered at specific times during playback. Used for footstep sounds, VFX spawning, gameplay triggers.

time.description: Trigger time in seconds from animation start.

type.description: Notify type identifier dispatched to Lua callbacks (e.g., 'footstep', 'spawn_vfx', 'play_sound').

properties.description: Notify-specific payload data passed to the callback.

source_take.description: Take/clip name in multi-take source files (FBX).
